channel.title: DegenKit Blog

item.title: What Is Elysium? Kinetiq''s Hyperliquid Layer 2 Explained
item.description: Elysium is Kinetiq's EVM Layer 2 for the Hyperliquid ecosystem, live since November 9, 2026. What it is, its chain ID, how gas works and what to check first.

item.title: How to Add Liquidity to a Solana Token on Raydium
item.description: How to add liquidity to a Solana token on Raydium with DegenKit. Pick SOL or USDC, set the starting price, create the pool in one signature and check it.

item.title: How to Burn Solana Tokens and Reduce Supply
item.description: How to burn Solana tokens from your wallet in one transaction, what burning changes on-chain, what it costs on DegenKit and how to check that the supply went down.

item.title: Can You Create a Solana Token for Free? Real Costs
